note: v3.33.1.0 Three Sovereigns, inclusion-over-citation policy (data 0.34.1.0). Measured with zlib.gzipSync.
reason: Raised deliberately for the before-and-after graph. `links` was populated on 15 of 1,765 entities while the application's stated purpose includes important before and after links; it now reaches 1,107. That is 1,788 link records, and they cost about 46 kB gzipped. A first attempt also wrote a 200-character provenance note onto every derived link, which this guard caught -- that part was waste and became a `derived` flag with the explanation shown once in the UI.
